<a id="nav-G"></a>
## G Architecture Governance

<a id="nav-G-1"></a>
**G.1 Governance Model**

<a id="nav-G-1-1"></a>
**G.1.1 Architecture Authority**

The Architecture Continuum supplies canonical architectural authority. Its canonical Principle elements solely define the Architectural Axioms. Governance contracts and accepted decisions retain their defined roles; publications and projections supply no independent architectural authority.

<a id="nav-G-1-2"></a>
**G.1.2 Decision Rights**

Mark Hunter, Solution Architect, holds final architectural decision and acceptance authority. The Architecture Review Board is the collaborative review and adjudication forum. Agents may analyse and implement authorised work; they cannot approve architecture or confirm their own architectural closure.

<a id="nav-G-1-3"></a>
**G.1.3 Roles and Responsibilities**

The Solution Architect adjudicates and confirms the incorporated result. Architecture peers and the ARB may challenge and recommend. Executing agents preserve operative instructions, actual application, evidence and uncertainty within the authorised scope.

<a id="nav-G-2"></a>
**G.2 Architecture Evidence**

<a id="nav-G-2-1"></a>
**G.2.1 Evidence before change**

The existing iteration-scoped before/ locations hold activity inputs and input provenance.

<a id="nav-G-2-2"></a>
**G.2.2 Evidence after change**

The existing iteration-scoped after/ locations hold outputs and output provenance.

<a id="nav-G-3"></a>
**G.3 Architecture Review**

<a id="nav-G-3-1"></a>
**G.3.1 Review records**

Pending HCRLs preserve material proposals, attributable dispositions, conditions and actual application facts for the governed transition. The review repository supplies no acceptance merely through location.

<a id="nav-G-3-2"></a>
**G.3.2 Pending architectural decisions/dispositions**

Unresolved architectural decisions and dispositions remain explicit in review records and qualified canonical elements. The accepted 1.1.10 transition defers 76 contextual classification questions; their meanings and standing remain unchanged. The completed 1.1.10 register records the accepted transition and its limits.

<a id="nav-G-4"></a>
**G.4 Architecture Register**

<a id="nav-G-4-1"></a>
**G.4.1 Accepted/completed governance records**

The existing register retains completed HCRLs after Solution Architect confirmation of the authorised change and actual incorporated result. Completed records are immutable under common governance.

<a id="nav-G-5"></a>
**G.5 Architecture Governance Processes**

<a id="nav-G-5-1"></a>
**G.5.1 Governed architecture Praxes**

<a id="nav-G-5-1-1"></a>
**G.5.1.1 Architecture Review Praxis**

<a id="nav-G-5-1-2"></a>
**G.5.1.2 Architecture Authoring Praxis**

<a id="nav-G-5-1-3"></a>
**G.5.1.3 Architectural Element Incorporation Praxis**

<a id="nav-G-5-1-4"></a>
**G.5.1.4 ArchiMate Round-Trip Engineering Praxis**

<a id="nav-G-6"></a>
**G.6 Architecture Principles and Compliance**

<a id="nav-G-6-1"></a>
**G.6.1 Application of canonical Architecture Principles**

Canonical Continuum Principle elements are the sole normative axiom definitions; this source supplies application context and links.

<a id="nav-G-6-2"></a>
**G.6.2 Compliance/conformance**

Current validation and reproducibility mechanisms provide bounded evidence; they do not establish architectural acceptance.

<a id="nav-G-7"></a>
**G.7 Architecture Repository and Authority**

<a id="nav-G-7-1"></a>
**G.7.1 Architecture Continuum**

Individually identified canonical Markdown elements own architectural meaning. The ordered canonical navigation describes architectural organisation; native types and relationships retain semantic meaning independently of that organisation.

<a id="nav-G-7-2"></a>
**G.7.2 Architecture publications and projections**

The Continuum Manifest is the structural catalogue and the Continuum RAD is the human-readable narrative. Archi/Open Exchange is the projection, workbench and interchange representation. All derive from canonical Continuum architecture and navigation.

<a id="nav-G-7-3"></a>
**G.7.3 Evidence**

The existing iteration-scoped evidence repository retains required Tasks, Reports and purpose-selected supporting material under the Architecture Change Provenance contract.

<a id="nav-G-7-4"></a>
**G.7.4 Review**

The existing review repository retains pending architectural proposals, adjudication and result-confirmation material with its recorded standing.

<a id="nav-G-7-5"></a>
**G.7.5 Register**

The existing register retains accepted/completed governance records; directory placement never manufactures the required Solution Architect decision.
